steps.label: Priya asks refunds-agent, the wrong agent, to merge PR 418
The gate refuses refunds-agent, because a merge is outside its job
refunds-agent hands the work to @merges in the room
coder picks it up from the role, and its merge is held
The hold is the holder's merge, and nobody told Clearance who asked
The card reaches Dev, who can decide it
Priya tries to approve the merge she asked for
Clearance refuses Priya, as the requester
Dev denies it on his card
The room hears it was denied by Dev
The ledger records the refusal, the hold, Priya's refused answer and the denial
